title: Straightway
summary: STRAIGHTWAY, adverb [straight and way.] Immediately; without loss of time; without delay. He took the damsel by the hand, and said to her, Talitha cumi--and straightway the damsel arose. Mark 5:41-42.

inlines.v: STRAIGHTWAY, adverb [straight and way.] Immediately; without loss of time; without delay. He took the damsel by the hand, and said to her, Talitha cumi--and straightway the damsel arose. Mark 5:41-42. [Straightways is obsolete.]
